{{Quote|You know, another thing most beings fail to realize about the Geonosians is that it's in your nature to be industrious.|Orson Krennic|<ref name="Catalyst">''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Geonosians''' were a winged, semi-[[insectoid]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] that created nests in large, spire-like colonies on their [[homeworld]]. The Geonosians would fight on the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]], defending their planet on multiple occasions. After contributing to the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], they were nearly [[Sterilization of Geonosis|exterminated]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]. Only a single Geonosian, nicknamed [[Klik-Klak]], survived the Imperial sterilization of their planet, but there was hope during the [[New Republic Era]] that some eggs could have also survived, creating hope that a new [[Geonosian hive]] could arise.

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Geonosians do not hold life to be as precious as you humans do, Lieutenant Commander.|Archduke Poggle the Lesser to Orson Krennic|<ref name="Catalyst" />}}
[[File:Poggle_Geo.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Poggle the Lesser was an Archduke.]]
A caste-based species separated by positions that included drones, [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)|warriors]], and [[Geonosian elite|elites]],<ref name="Scene to Stats">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/scene-to-stats-geonosian-warriors|text=Scene to Stats: Geonosian Warriors}}</ref> Geonosians were born into hives with each led by a [[queen]]. The queen laid eggs for the hive, and provided orders to the [[Archduke|public leaders]] of Geonosis.<ref name="dataqueen">{{Databank|queen-karina-the-great|Queen Karina the Great}}</ref> One such queen, [[Karina the Great]], was even able to control sentient beings, including her own kind, via the use of [[brain worm]]s.<ref name="LoT">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref> It was believed by some that "Karina the Great" was the name assigned to every reigning queen, instead of being the name of one specific individual,<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars New">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> but one queen only called herself "[[Karina]]" because of her own insanity.<ref name="Rebels Recon Warhead">{{RebelsRecon|EfCuHRbbTZk|#3.14: Inside "Warhead" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-warhead}}</ref> No matter the case, Geonosian queens resided underground in the [[Geonosian catacombs|catacombs]] of Geonosis. From here, they commanded an [[army]]'s worth of Geonosian drones.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars New" /> Queens took no more than two years to grow from a small egg to a considerable size.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis">{{Rebels|Ghosts of Geonosis}}</ref><ref name="Darth Vader 4">[[Darth Vader (2015) 4|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 4]]</ref>

Even though they were born without wings,<ref name="Warriors2025">{{NewLegion|set=Geonosian Warriors Unit Expansion (new edition)}}</ref> drones were capable of becoming warriors if they proved themselves worthy by successfully defeating other drones in an [[Petranaki Arena|arena]].<ref name="Catalyst" /> Geonosians of the warrior caste were known as Geonosian warriors. They had wings and a thick exoskeleton, and they were dedicated to warfare.<ref name="Front">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref> Among Geonosian [[Brood (Geonosian)|broods]], the alpha was known as the [[Geonosian Brood Alpha]].<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref> Geonosians also had two sets of mandibles, outer and inner, which they used to gesture. For example, clicking the outer mandibles twice meant "Work Harder," and clicking both sets meant "Die."<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> Geonosians also celebrated [[Meckgin]], a day in which they celebrated the virtues of industry, and believed themselves to be have been blessed by a being known as "the [[Creator]]."<ref name="Catalyst" /> Geonosians would get drunk by eating a special [[fungus]] which reacted with their [[stomach]] fluids to create a body odor which created euphoria.<ref name="AEYNTK" />

The Geonosians had [[Color|yellow]]-colored [[blood]].<ref name="irotrb">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''</ref> Geonosians could also be [[Force-sensitive|sensitive]] to [[the Force]].<ref name="Adventures 1">[[The High Republic Adventures (2022) 1|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2022) 1]]</ref> Naturally industrious and barbaric, they were also known to take upon construction projects from outside parties, as was the case when [[Baktoid Armor Workshop]] approached them to design [[Factory|factories]] for the [[Trade Federation]]. Productivity was key to Geonosian society, and if not kept in check with enough tasks, hives could devolve into civil war and result in the deaths of thousands of Geonosians.<ref name="Catalyst" />

The Geonosians showed a certain mistrust towards [[bounty hunter]]s. Nevertheless, they allowed the [[Mandalorian]] bounty hunter [[Jango Fett]], who was under the employ of [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]], into their hives during the Separatist Crisis.<ref name="AotC" />

==History==
====Pre-Clone Wars====
Long ago, the Geonosians inhabited Geonosis' surface. However they were driven underground by a series of mass extinctions caused by meteorites and radiation storms.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

====Clone Wars====
[[File:GeonosianUndead-LoT.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Geonosian [[zombie]]s during the Second Battle of Geonosis.]]
By [[32 BBY]],<ref name="32 BBY date note">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Poggle the Lesser - Geonosian Separatist}} establishes that [[Poggle the Lesser]] became [[archduke]] ten [[Standard year|years]] before making a [[droid]]-making deal with [[Count]] Dooku. As Poggle and the [[Geonosian]]s were making [[battle droid]]s for Dooku by [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the events of which are dated to [[22 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', Poggle must have become archduke by [[32 BBY]].</ref> a Geonosian named [[Poggle the Lesser]] had risen from the drone caste to that of archduke<ref name="Catalyst" /> with help from the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Poggle card">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Poggle the Lesser - Geonosian Separatist}}</ref> During the reign of Poggle, Geonosis became a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Separatists used the Geonosians to help create the [[Separatist Droid Army]]<ref name="AotC" /> after the Separatist [[Head of State]], [[Count]] [[Dooku]], personally arrived to negotiate the agreement.<ref name="Catalyst" />

This eventually led to a [[First Battle of Geonosis|large battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the Separatists on Geonosis, marking the official outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]]. The Geonosians were the ones responsible for creating the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="AotC" /><ref name="Geonosian" /> Later in the Clone Wars, Geonosis was the site of another major [[Second Battle of Geonosis|battle]], which saw Poggle the Lesser captured and the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry]] destroyed.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> Sometime after this second battle, the Republic's [[Strategic Advisory Cell]] began to build the battle station that would one day be known as the Death Star, with [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] enlisting Poggle the Lesser to make the Geonosians serve as the Republic's workforce. Poggle appeared to agree, but, sometime after he returned to Geonosis, he arranged a Geonosian [[Uprising on Geonosis|riot]] and escaped the [[Geonosis Republic flotilla|Republic flotilla]] to return to the Confederacy.<ref name="Catalyst" />

====Imperial Era====
{{Quote|The Geonosians are a servant species. They are forbidden from breeding freely.|Darth Vader, to Orson Krennic|<ref name="Vader Annual 2">[[Darth Vader Annual 2|''Darth Vader Annual'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:Construction_of_the_Death_Star.png|thumb|left|250px|The Death Star was built by the Geonosians above Geonosis.]]
Following the Clone Wars, the Geonosians were forced by the [[Galactic Empire]] to assist in the construction of the Death Star. Though a [[Unidentified Geonosian archduke|new archduke]] was appointed to lead the [[Stalgasin hive]], the Geonosians became an enslaved<ref name="Catalyst" /> servant species to the Empire and were forbidden from freely breeding.<ref name="Vader Annual 2" /> When the Geonosians were unable to work out how to refine the superweapon's [[superlaser]], the Empire brought in [[Galen Walton Erso]] to finish the job.<ref name="Catalyst" /> The Geonosians of the [[Korakanni Mound]] attempted to sabotage the project and reach out to Erso for help by sending him an [[ootheca]], but they were [[Skirmish in the Korakanni Mound|crushed]] by [[Darth]] Vader.<ref name="Vader Annual 2" />

After the Death Star's [[hyperdrive]] was operational, [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] ordered the [[Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research|Imperial Weapons division]] to sterilize Geonosis using [[Imperial gas canister]]s,<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /><ref name="Rebels Recon Ghosts">{{RebelsRecon|NM7pTSxJKyY|#3.11: Inside "Ghosts of Geonosis" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-ghosts-of-geonosis}}</ref> destroying all but [[Klik-Klak|one]] of the planet's population<ref name="Klik-Klak">{{Databank|klik-klak|Klik-Klak}}</ref> of approximately 100 billion—the largest genocide ever committed by the Empire to keep the weapon a secret.<ref name="AEYNTK" />

====Post-sterilization====
In [[2 BBY]], [[Saw Gerrera]],<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> the [[Spectres]], and [[Captain]] [[Rex]] uncovered evidence that the Empire had perpetrated genocide against the Geonosian species. They also helped [[Klik-Klak]],<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> the sole survivor of the sterilization,<ref name="Klik-Klak" /> escape with the last Geonosian queen egg into the depths of Geonosis. The rebels informed [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] and [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] who believed that news of the Empire's atrocities on Geonosis would sway more worlds to the rebellion.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

Unfortunately for Klik-Klak,<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> his plan didn't last.<ref name="Darth Vader Part IV" /> Although the egg did eventually hatch into a queen who called herself [[Karina]],<ref name="Rebels Recon Warhead" /> the last known Geonosian Queen<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> was rendered sterile. Karina used the vast technological resources of Geonosis to attach herself to a portable [[droid]] factory. From this, she generated specially [[Droid worker|modified]] [[B1-series battle droid]]s, which were made to resemble her people. Although they were artificial mockeries of the Geonosians, Karina considered them to be her children.<ref name="Darth Vader Part IV" />

Karina ultimately lost this womb and many of her children when [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], accompanied by [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra]], [[assassin droid]] [[0-0-0]], and [[BT-1 assassin droid]] [[BT-1]], arrived and stole it from her in order to build his own droid army shortly after the destruction of the first [[Death Star]]. Even so, Karina survived the encounter and proclaimed that this set back would not be the end of her [[Karina's empire|empire]].<ref name="Darth Vader Part IV" /> Another Geonosian, a hunter named [[Pehk]], was alive in the galaxy but killed during the [[hunt on X3-299-11]].<ref name="Aphra Annual 2">[[Doctor Aphra Annual 2|''Doctor Aphra Annual'' 2]]</ref> Rumors persisted into the [[New Republic Era]] that a small number of Geonosian eggs could have survived, lending hope to the idea that a new hive could one day emerge.<ref name="TFA Head-to-Head">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: Head-to-Head]]''</ref>

==Geonosians in the galaxy==
[[Arkik Von]] was a Force-sensitive Geonosian who gave into the [[dark side of the Force]] and acted as a member of the [[Sorcerers of Tund]] for a time, only to later leave that group.<ref name="THRCE">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> As leader of the [[Dank Graks]] criminal faction,<ref name="Adventures 1" /> Von attempted to usurp control of the planet [[Takodana]] from [[Maz Kanata]] and the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="THRCE" /> During the Clone Wars, the Geonosians were part of a [[Battle on Rishi|Confederate plot]] on [[Rishi]] involving the material [[exonium]].<ref name="Mustafar and Other Outer Rim Planets">{{EncyclopediaCite|Mustafar and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}}</ref> A [[Unidentified Geonosian colony|Geonosian colony]] was established on a [[Unidentified Geonosian colony moon|moon]]. By the time antiques dealer [[Antron Bach]] went into hiding on the moon, the colony had long been abandoned.<ref name="The End of History">{{InsiderCite|154|The End of History}}</ref>

Pehk was a Geonosian hunter who gained notoriety for being the first person to headbutt a [[gundark]]. However, he was hired by Doctor Aphra for the hunt on the world of [[X3-299-11]]. Aphra wanted to be rescued from the [[Shadowfang Beast]], but Pehk was caught in a [[tractor beam]] trap. After monster hunters [[Winloss]] and [[Nokk]] were hired by Aphra and arrived, Pehk was killed by the creature.<ref name="Aphra Annual 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Concept and development===
{{Quote|Doug e-mailed me a picture Iain had done for the Neimoidian face from Episode I, and I went from there. That design was too good not to use.|[[Dermot Power]], and mentioning [[Iain McCaig]] as well|<ref name="The Art of AotC">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>}}
[[File:GeonosianConceptArt.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Concept art by [[Terryl Whitlatch]].]]
When George Lucas was coming up with concept art for the Geonosians, Lucas was dealing with a [[Wikipedia:Termite|termite]] infestation in his house, which inspired the Geonosians. Lucas then gathered specimens and showed them to concept artists.<ref name="7 things">{{SW|url=news/7-things-you-might-not-know-about-the-making-of-the-star-wars-prequels|text=7 Things You Might Not Know About the Making of the ''Star Wars'' Prequels}}</ref><ref name="Geonosian Inspiration">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-8-things-you-might-not-know-about-geonosians|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Geonosians}}</ref> The basic design of the Geonosians originated from unused orignal concept art of the [[Neimoidian]]s which resembled B1 battle droids. This art was created before it was decided that they would be played by masked actors.<ref name="Old DB">{{DB|species|geonosian|Geonosian}}</ref><ref name="Geonosian Inspiration" /> The Geonosian language that was known as "[[Geonosian hive-mind]]" was created from three sounds recorded by [[Matthew Wood]] under the direction of [[Ben Burtt]] while in [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]]. In the city of [[Wikipedia:|Melbourne]], Wood recorded the mating cries of [[Wikipedia:Penguin|penguins]] at a reserve. In the city of [[Wikipedia:Cairns|Cairns]], Wood recorded a group of [[Wikipedia:Megabat|fruit bats]] fighting over a banana. While in Australia, Wood also recorded the sounds of flying foxes. Burtt mixed all of these sounds and created the Geonosian language.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="Geonosian Inspiration" />

According to concept artist [[Doug Chiang]], before the final design for the Geonosians was pitched, George Lucas originally desired to have the species to take on a chameleon-like quality and be able to change colors based on their surroundings. Though that idea eventually got nixed, the texture and color of the Geonosians do match that of their homeworld Geonosis.<ref name="Geonosian Inspiration">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-8-things-you-might-not-know-about-geonosians|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Geonosians}}</ref>

The inspiration for the Geonosians' role as the ones assigned to construct the Death Star came from a scene in the [[1994]] film [[Wikipedia:Clerks (film)|''Clerks'']], in which the main characters ponder the lives of the "independent contractors" during the construction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]].<ref name="Clerks">Excerpt from ''Clerks'' and {{Film|II}}, the latter featuring George Lucas's commentary. https://youtu.be/cFKhV_X6-cg</ref>
